decision.classification: Observed lane-A run regression in rank1 D and Bh; transient host/queue/placement interaction plausible, permanent physical-card effect unproven
excluded_explanations: rank0 A becoming the hit bottleneck
decision.next_device_evidence: Card1 and card3 target-head plus shared/separate expanded-draft-prefix timings, per-stage draft copies/submission/event span/publication; two fresh matched engine brackets with unchanged output and acceptance gates
unresolved: target-head isolated device duration on cards1/3

host_topology_snapshot.scope: Passive sysfs snapshot after screens; not historical link telemetry

method.caution: Medians are descriptive and not additive; means provide exact critical-path accounting. Gaps are residuals, so the accounting identity is not independent proof of causal completeness. Draft wall minus compute-event sum includes transfers, queue gaps, waits and host work; it is not pure CPU time. One fresh candidate per lane is not repeat evidence.
method.comparisons: candidate minus arithmetic mean of two control summaries; also prompt/position matched first99 deltas
method.components: packet85 intervals(): D rank1 op9(pos); B rank1 op1(pos,false); A rank0 op1(pos+1,true); R op3(pos,true); C rank0 op1(pos,false)
method.draft_event_sum: rank1 op1 gpu_ms carries deferred previous draft events; target half/head not event-profiled
method.draft_row_join: receipt draft_rows[position+1], verified by draft_started_monotonic == op9.sent; rank1 draft-rows.jsonl draft_position == position-1
method.duration: 1000*(rank_completed-rank_received), command envelopes, not isolated device kernels
method.hit_label: guess_rows[position] at starting emission; miss correction acts before next emission
method.secondary_window: all 127 intervals of each 128-token capped request
method.summary_hit_miss: median across 12 per-request means over all 127 intervals; not pooled interval medians

scope: CPU-only retrospective screen analysis; no promotion or device experiment
